title: Choose ScholarKey's visual world
question: Re-roll 1 assigned the Grading Report. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll again.

options.label: Grading Report
options.lineage: Gemological laboratory grading reports: report number, plotting diagrams, measured scales, checked online by number
options.thesis: A diploma examined like a gem: every check printed as a measured result, and the document itself plotted like an inclusion map.
options.viewport: The page is one grading report: a ruled results column lists the five examinations as empty fields, the document plot on the right is where you drop a diploma PDF, and the report number, QR and 'Issue credentials' run down a narrow sidebar.
options.risk: Lab precision can read cold, and gems carry luxury baggage: it must stay an instrument's honesty, never jewellery glamour.

raised.raise: Show the check before it runs: all five examinations are pre-printed as empty fields and fill in order.
State is a mark, not a hue: tick, plotted cross, open circle and 'not examined' read in grayscale and on a washed-out projector.
A visible point of no return: the anchor step is marked as a permanent public record before the registrar commits.
The drop target announces itself the moment a file is dragged anywhere over the page.
The diagram is true and numbered: callouts 1–4 on the document plot map to the result rows, and unreached checks stay visible as 'Not examined'.
Every reading prints its measured value with units in tabular figures: ms, bytes hashed, block height.

options.label: Security Printing
options.lineage: Banknote and passport security printing: guilloche, microtext, intaglio
options.thesis: The visual language of things that cannot be forged, now protecting a diploma.
options.viewport: A banknote-proportioned field: a guilloche rosette is the drop target, microtext lines spell the five checks, and the serial number is the credential ID.
options.risk: The most familiar 'secure document' language; it slides toward government bureaucracy when the ornament wins.

options.label: Algorave Floor
options.thesis: Verification as live code on a stage: each check a line that runs.
options.viewport: A projected buffer where each verification line evaluates on the beat.
options.case: Registrars and recruiters do not identify with live coding, and neon on black is the rejected look.
options.kept: Upcoming changes are visible before they happen.
options.risk: Developer spectacle over a trust verdict.

options.label: Cutting Bench Rail
options.thesis: Each check a punched frame on a perforated rail, marked done or flagged.
options.viewport: A perforated rail crosses the page; the dropped PDF threads through five frames.
options.case: Disciplined system, but the film-editing metaphor explains nothing about authenticity to this audience.
options.kept: State is a mark, not a hue.
options.risk: Insider craft metaphor; orange-on-black reads as a costume here.

options.label: Accretion Threshold
options.thesis: Issuance as matter crossing an irreversible horizon.
options.viewport: A glowing disk where each credential falls past the horizon onto the ledger.
options.case: Cosmic glow is crypto-adjacent and says nothing a recruiter can check.

options.label: Luminescent Understory
options.thesis: Paths light themselves as you approach the document.
options.viewport: A dark forest floor where dragging a PDF lights a path to the verdict.
options.case: Dreamlike glow undermines certainty; weak audience fit.
options.kept: Destinations announce themselves at a distance.
options.risk: Fantasy where precision is the promise.

options.label: Ekiben Wrapper
options.thesis: Each credential a wrapped box whose printed contents map is true.
options.viewport: A lid printed with the university's landmark; sliding the band reveals the verified contents map.
options.case: Charming but culturally foreign to the audience and soft for a fraud-proof claim.
options.kept: A numbered contents map that is true, with honest absence.

options.label: Crisis Command Wall
options.thesis: Verification as a crisis wall: counters, chevrons, condition bars.
options.viewport: Seven-segment counters tick through each check under hazard bands.
options.case: Alarmist and neon on black: wrong register for trust.
options.kept: Every reading carries a measured counter.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean trust SaaS page: verify academic credentials instantly.
canonCard.viewport: Centred headline over an upload box, three feature cards below, logos strip.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every credential startup by design.
